verdicts.title: Consecutive Quadratic Residues And Quadratic Nonresidue Modulo $p$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $p$ be a large prime, and let $k\ll \log p$. A new proof of the existence of any pattern of $k$ consecutive quadratic residues and quadratic nonresidues is introduced in this note. Further, an application to the least quadratic nonresidues $n_p$ modulo $p$ shows that $n_p\ll (\log p)(\log \log p)$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns patterns of consecutive quadratic residues/nonresidues and bounds on the least quadratic nonresidue n_p ≪ (log p)(log log p), with no mention of communication complexity, rank variance, or counting residues representing protocol outcomes.
